name: camofox-mcp
description: Complete MCP tools and managed setup for the Camofox headless browser.

interface.longDescription: Control a local Camofox browser through complete MCP tools. Explicit setup installs the pinned server and browser engine. Managed sessions use a private authenticated loopback service; existing servers can also be connected.
defaultPrompt: Set up Camofox and check browser health.
Use Camofox to browse a website.
